title: SK Steel — HRC 58–62

title: White Steel #1 (Shirogami 1) — HRC 62–65

title: Blue Steel #1 (Aogami 1) — HRC 62–65

title: VG-5 (Takefu) — HRC 59–61

title: ATS-34 (Hitachi) — HRC 60–62

title: Gyuto
body: Japanese chef's knife. Versatile all-purpose blade. 180–270mm.

title: Santoku
body: Three virtues: meat, fish, vegetables. Shorter, lighter than gyuto. 165–190mm.

title: Nakiri
body: Vegetable knife. Straight edge for push-cutting. 150–180mm.

title: Sujihiki
body: Slicing knife. Long, thin blade minimises tearing. 240–330mm.

title: Bunka
body: Reverse tanto tip. Great for precision cuts. 165–200mm.

title: Honesuki
body: Boning knife. Stiff triangular blade for poultry. 145–165mm.

title: Petty
body: Small utility knife for detail work and peeling. 120–180mm.

title: Deba
body: Heavy fish butchery knife. Handles heads, bones and scales. 150–210mm.

title: Yanagiba
body: Sashimi slicer. Long pull-cut for clean fish slices. 240–360mm.

title: Usuba
body: Vegetable knife for katsuramuki thin sheets. 180–240mm.

title: Kiritsuke
body: Multi-purpose single-bevel. Extremely difficult to master. Status symbol.

title: Sakai Takayuki
body: One of the largest Sakai producers. Wide range from entry-level to professional grade.

title: Takeshi Saji

body: Traditional maker known for exceptional single-bevel knives and hand finishing.

title: Yoshimi Kato
body: Award-winning blacksmith. Exceptional grinds, SG2 and Damascus specialist.

title: Yu Kurosaki
body: Modern master. Innovative surface patterns, exceptional balance and fit & finish.

title: Tosa Tradition
body: Kochi Prefecture. Utilitarian high-performance knives with excellent value.

title: Honbazuke
body: Initial edge setting by the maker. Establishes the final cutting geometry.

title: Honyaki
body: Single steel construction. Highest grade, hamon visible. Requires expert maintenance.

title: Kasumi

title: Kurouchi

title: Mune

title: Shinogi

body: Sujihiki. Long blade covers the full cut, minimising tearing.

title: Detail / Garnish

title: Never dishwasher
body: Hand wash and dry immediately. Dishwashers destroy handles and edges.

body: Wood or plastic only. Glass and ceramic destroy any edge quickly.

title: Storage
